title: Typesense guide (paraphrase)
text: Typesense is an open-source search engine licensed under GPL-3.0 that can be self-hosted. Requests are authenticated with API keys, including scoped search-only keys. Typesense keeps its index in memory, so the documented operational requirement is enough RAM for the indexed data. High availability is provided by running a cluster of nodes that replicate with the Raft consensus protocol.
